resolution: TIZ is an execution/process-discipline boundary, not a market-derived direction producer.
source_basis: Trading in the Zone principles already integrated in THREE_BOOK_INTEGRATION.json and preserved by the existing TIZ fail-closed and optional-evaluation contracts.

semantics.risk_acceptance: consume authoritative Risk boundary result; do not recreate Risk
semantics.rule_adherence: consume authoritative selected-rule/execution evidence; do not infer intent
semantics.impulse_override: explicit process-event evidence only; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE
semantics.loss_sequence_control: explicit process-event evidence only; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE
semantics.revenge_trade: explicit process-event evidence only; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE
semantics.post_trade_review: record-only process output; never direction logic
semantics.no_impulsive_override: explicit process-event evidence only; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE

closure_statement: The previous blocker was caused by treating TIZ as if it required a market-data-derived psychological producer. The authoritative boundary is now resolved as a process-evidence interface. A historical market series cannot legitimately manufacture private psychological state; when such process evidence is absent, TIZ remains NOT_EVALUABLE. This does not block the isolated 2025 OOS evaluation mode, while canonical three-book production remains fail-closed.
